description: This file contains a class `AzureAIRerankConfig` that extends `CohereRerankConfig` to provide configuration and transformation methods for integrating Azure AI's rerank API into the existing rerank processing framework. It includes methods for constructing API URLs, validating environment credentials, and transforming rerank responses.

classes.name: AzureAIRerankConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Azure AI rerank, extending CohereRerankConfig, providing methods for URL construction, environment validation, and response transformation specific to Azure AI's rerank API.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the complete API URL for Azure AI rerank, appending '/v1/rerank' if necessary.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Prepares and validates the headers with API key and other necessary headers for Azure AI rerank API requests.

methods.name: RerankResponse transform_rerank_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: RerankResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_key: Optional[str] = None, request_data: dict = {}, optional_params: dict = {}, litellm_params: dict = {}, )
methods.description: Transforms the raw API response into a `RerankResponse`, extracting and setting the model base name tailored for Azure AI.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_base_model(self, azure_model_group: Optional[str])
methods.description: Determines and returns the base model string based on Azure model group labels.
